APPROVE

The patch moves the prerequisite loop, with its `break` and `TryGetValue` branches, into `AppendPrerequisites`. That drops the nested `foreach` and both `if`s from `AppendMakeRecipes`, so its cognitive complexity should fall well below 15. Order, the `MaxMakeTargets` break and the `AppendRule` calls are the same, so behaviour is unchanged. The build looks safe, though I could not compile it or see the surrounding code, so I assumed `rules`, `variables` and `appended` already match the new parameter types.
